notes:
Discovery notes and POC plan (fragments):
- Company: ForgeSight Systems — IDE/CLI-first devtools startup (code search + completions).
- Primary ask: repo-aware code assistant in IDEs (VS Code plugin + internal monorepo support). Emphasis on low per-token latency for streaming completions and deterministic model pinning.
- Workload: mixed — interactive completions (low-latency streaming), batched repo indexing for embeddings, reranking for search results. Target latency: token start <50ms on dedicated capacity for completions; tail p99 <120ms. Throughput: expect ~80-150 concurrent users during dev hours, ~120 QPS peak for completions.
- Context retrieval: must support repo-aware retrieval. Prefer chunking at function-level + file-level fallback. Want ability to tune chunk size per repo (200-800 tokens).
- Vector DB: security requirement for data residency — leaning to on-prem Milvus/Weaviate or Dedicated VPC-managed vector DB. No SaaS vector DB unless in VPC. Asked about Redwood-managed vectorstore (hosted) & encryption-at-rest w/ KMS.
- Model/versioning: critical to pin production copilots to a specific model hash. Need stable rollout + rollback (canary). Also want ability to route dev users to newer model versions.
- Caching & batching: want to understand Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching without breaking token-latency SLOs. Interested in prefix caching for repeated prompts (CLI snippets).
- Security: Okta SSO mandatory, audit logs retention 2 years, support for customer KMS + key rotation, legal wants data residency clause for EU-only repos.
- Quotes from call: "We need completions that feel instant in-editor — anything >100ms feels sluggish." — Eng lead.
- POC scope agreed: 2-week POC to validate streaming latency, retrieval relevance, and model-pinning workflows. POC deliverables: latency report, ranking eval (nDCG on dev queries), integration notes for VS Code plugin.
- Internal stakeholders: Eng lead (Maya Chen), Head of Security (Daniel Ortiz), Platform PM (Ravi Kumar). AE/SE sync cadence: weekly.
- Integration notes: will provide 3 representative repos (monorepo, microservices, infra scripts). Engineering to provide SSH/VM access for on-prem vector DB node, or Redwood to deploy within customer VPC.
- Action items: SE to supply POC playbook + env checklist; legal to receive template residency clause; infra to receive perf test harness.
- Risks: indexing cadence for monorepo (large history), cache invalidation on frequent commits, license review for third-party model weights.
- Jira refs: raised INF-1284 for POC infra, SEC-451 for KMS/keys questions.
- Short call notes: 2026-03-02 demo + Q&A (ff_20260302_0112_forgesight_call).
